messages:
carla: Heads-up — planning a schema change + partitioned backfill for tenant_metadata during the Tue 03/23 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Adds partition_id (INT) and moves hot rows to new range partitions. Needs deploybot canary + service version pin to v2.14. Link to plan: https://go/redwood/infra/tenant-metadata-backfill :eyes:
ben: Saw the plan — overall looks sane. Concern: the ALTER ADD COLUMN might take locks if ran on the primary. Are we doing an ADD COLUMN NULL first + backfill in CTAS to avoid table rewrite?
dave: plan is ADD COLUMN NULL, then create tenant_metadata_new as partitioned CTAS and swap with pg_swap_table. We need to coordinate read replica lag checks. If replicas lag > 10s we should pause Canary.
carla: Correct — steps in order: 1) add nullable column, 2) create partitioned table via CTAS in chunks, 3) verify counts, 4) pg_swap_table rename, 5) vacuum/analyze. Canary will run against two shards first.
alice: Will the CTAS be online? Any long-running exclusive locks? Need to avoid locking writes for >30s.
dave: CTAS + INSERT in chunks (100k rows/chunk) — should be non-blocking. We will use this snippet for chunk loop:
```sh
for range in $(seq 0 365); do
  psql -c "INSERT INTO tenant_metadata_new PARTITION FOR (date '$range') SELECT * FROM tenant_metadata WHERE created_at >= ... LIMIT 100000;"
done
```
carla: exact chunking script and thresholds are in the runbook (see link). We'll abort if any chunk takes >5m or if any INSERT hits lock_wait > 30s per pg_stat_activity.
sofia: Request: pin api-service to v2.14 and search-indexer to v1.7 during window. Search indexers read tenant_metadata — we don't want a mismatch. Can we add a feature-flag toggle as quick rollback?
carla: Yes — feature flag `tm_partitioned_reads` will gate reading the new partitioned table. Rollback plan: flip flag to false + swap back original table if needed. Expected rollback time ~15min.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-23 02:05 UTC (canary group: shard-3, shard-7). If canary fails, will auto-abort and notify #eng-oncall.
migrator-bot: Preflight checks: replica_lag_seconds=3, long_tx_count=0, avg_lock_wait=0.4s. All green. Will emit watch metrics to /metrics/tenant_metadata/backfill.
ben: One more ask — update release notes: mention partitioning and that customer-visible API unaffected. I'll add a short blurb.
carla: Thanks. I've added a line in the release notes draft and attached the migration checklist. :thumbsup:
dave: We'll also keep pg_stat_activity watch queries running and an ops pager on-call for the window. If we observe >5% unexpected write errors, abort and revert.
alice: ack — I'll be standing by for the canary results and will monitor traces.
sofia: I'll pin search-indexer and set the feature flag pre-window. After a successful canary + 20m steady-state we'll un-pin and roll forward.
carla: Final: during the window we'll not schedule other heavy jobs (backfills, reindexes). If anything blocks, use the escape hatch: `DEPLOY_HOLD` in deploy-bot with reason.
ben: lgtm.
carla: +1 — thanks everyone. I'll update the runbook with the final timings and post the rollback checklist here before the window starts.
